ranking_basis: Scientific impact and measurable evidence; categories overlap and are not additive.

modes.failure_mode: Weak confidence separation and missed detections at usable precision
modes.evidence: At the inherited automatic point: 2828/4907 FN and 2267/4346 FP; 2059 FN have a one-to-one correct-class match when the floor is lowered to 0.001. Original/replayed confusion has 147326 background FP at that floor.
modes.prevalence: 57.6% of annotations missed; 72.8% of those misses have an eligible match at the floor. Different threshold matchings can reassign boxes.
modes.likely_cause: Poor score ordering/separation among defects and competing textures; calibration versus representation cannot be disentangled here.
modes.confidence: High for observation, moderate/low for mechanism
modes.addressable: Potentially model/training; lowering a threshold alone trades in many false positives.

modes.evidence: mAP50 0.388424 versus mAP50-95 0.216993; Hole AP50 0.418557 versus AP75 0.126640. 654/2267 diagnostic FP overlap same-class GT at IoU 0.1 to <0.5.
modes.prevalence: 28.8% of diagnostic FP in the exclusive localization category; overlaps with other GT-side failure mechanisms.
modes.likely_cause: Box extent errors, thin boxes, nearby instances, and overlapping/ambiguous GT extents.
modes.confidence: High for localization weakness; moderate for attribution
modes.addressable: Potentially resolution/representation; ambiguous annotation policy cannot be solved by training configuration alone.

modes.evidence: Tiny recall 28.1%, tiny FN rate 71.9%; minimum input side <4 px recall 6.9% (5/72). Tiny Breakage 1/41; tiny Reinforcement 115/409. Source crops visibly lose detail at 640.
modes.prevalence: Tiny: 441/2828 FN (15.6%); tiny+small: 1283/2828 FN (45.4%) vs 42.1% of instances. Substantial, not the majority of all errors.
modes.likely_cause: Limited spatial evidence at input/feature scale; scene density and class composition also contribute.
modes.confidence: High for association, moderate for resolution hypothesis
modes.addressable: Yes, single input-resolution change is a testable hypothesis.

modes.evidence: At conf 0.001/IoU 0.45: Breakage GT -> Honeycombing 297, reverse 114; Hole GT -> Reinforcement 61. At the analysis point Honeycombing has 516 FP versus 270 TP.
modes.prevalence: 1073 off-diagonal foreground matches in original/replayed floor confusion matrix; 196/2267 diagnostic FP are high-overlap wrong-class predictions.
modes.likely_cause: Shared damaged-concrete textures and co-located defects; reviewed examples contain ambiguous class semantics.
modes.confidence: High for label-based counts, moderate for semantic cause
modes.addressable: Potentially; class sampling alone is not supported as the first change.

modes.evidence: Dense >=7 boxes: recall 38.4% vs sparse 1-2: 52.1%; 227 dense images contain 1469 FN. Within small-size strata recall is about 42% across typical/dense scenes.
modes.prevalence: 51.9% of FN occur in dense scenes containing 48.6% of GT; 506/613 tiny GT are in dense scenes.
modes.likely_cause: Partly size/class mixture, plus clustered instances; independent density effect not established.
modes.confidence: High for association, low/moderate for mechanism
modes.addressable: Potentially, but no NMS change or separate density experiment is justified now.

modes.failure_mode: Visual/annotation ambiguity and limited source information
modes.evidence: Reviewed 9199, 12001, 12297 and 11992; broad overlapping class regions and plausible defects without matching labels. 12305 is only 550x413 pixels.
modes.prevalence: Not estimated: purposive qualitative review is not a prevalence sample.
modes.likely_cause: Ambiguous boundaries/semantics, blur and original resolution limits.
modes.confidence: Moderate for examples; no dataset-wide annotation-error claim
modes.addressable: Not reliably by one training setting; annotations remain untouched.
